raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (the latest delivery) sends customer_id unpadded (C3, C94, C180) while raw_customers uses 5-digit zero-padded ids (C00003). The inner join in gold_region_daily therefore drops about 363 rows, which matches the 4630 vs 4267 gap, and gold_customer_spend splits those customers across two keys. Normalizing the id to the padded format in silver_transactions fixes it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(customer_id, '^C[0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(customer_id, 2), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
